lines: The community garden behind the old library
was built by residents who wanted a place
where children could learn about growing food
without having to travel outside the city.
Every Saturday, a different volunteer opens
the gate and checks the watering system.
Visitors can borrow small tools from the shed,
but they need to return them before closing.
This simple arrangement has kept
the garden welcoming and easy to maintain.
